description: This file declares the LocalTracer class and related classes/interfaces for tracing and messaging within the WPEFramework project. It includes class definitions, method declarations, and inline implementations related to message handling, thread management, and callback mechanisms for local tracing functionality.

classes.name: LocalTracer
classes.description: Main class providing local tracing and messaging functionalities, including thread management, message enabling/disabling, callback registration, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: LocalTracer::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback implementations to handle message notifications.

classes.name: LocalTracer::MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class managing message unit settings, ensuring proper load and access.

classes.name: LocalTracer::WorkerThread
classes.description: Thread class responsible for running the worker loop that dispatches messages.

classes.name: LocalTracer::ConsolePrinter
classes.description: Implementation of ICallback that outputs messages to the console, with optional abbreviated formatting.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Open
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the singleton instance of LocalTracer, initializing necessary resources.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Close
methods.description: Cleans up resources, stops worker thread, and deletes the singleton instance.

methods.name: LocalTracer::EnableMessage
methods.description: Enables or disables tracing messages for a specific module and category.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Dispatch
methods.description: Processes incoming messages and calls the registered callback.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Callback
methods.description: Registers a callback object to receive message notifications.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Message
methods.description: Internal method to deliver a message to the registered callback.
